opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public, listed at Grade I/II* or Scheduled Monument (or equivalent in Scotland/NI).
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open and accessible to the public, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, focussed on professional performance with the performing arts constituting the vast majority of its activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK working with disability; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects which help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK working in mental health; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards projects for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for places providing excellent care to patients and their families in hospices and palliative care. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance; fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK running special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects which support pupils at secondary level in special schools and colleges to develop skills to gain employment or live independently after school or college. Two-stage application process. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK, with at least two years of exam results, an Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI overall outcome of 'Good' or above, and demonstrable excellence or significant progress towards excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process in 2026. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
